title: Member cards: one link on the card, the owner sets what a tap opens from Crew or the Space admin, tied into Zaps
detail: Owner ask 2026-10-22: a tiered two-way NFC system where members set their card's link and/or virtual card from their own console, Space check-in points stay, it feels exclusive, and it is fully tied into the game (proposal https://claude.ai/artifact/AxBeznV9ovDZDsCPSjvi9M, ADR-1874). The chip keeps SITE_URL/c/<token>; card_faces holds the face: page (the owner's own page, the default), card (virtual card with Save contact and Swap contacts) or link, plus pause. Crew hub /crew/card is the member's editor (CardFaceEditor + CardPreview, stats, stage, their cards with on/off, Ask for my card for Crew); the Space's Check-in workspace has Your Space card (the Space face, a cardholder perk for every plan, the Space's cards). /c/<token> routes by the face: owner tap opens /crew/card, a signed-out tap on a member card in page mode shows the public face at /card/<token> (profiles need sign-in), a signed-in member tap files the owner into the tapper's My Contacts (source nfc_card) and pays both meetup_tap Zaps through card_meet() (one meet per pair per week, shared with Tap to meet). Swap contacts writes a consent-given contact into the owner's book (or a sealed share_back Space lead) and pays the owner card_swap Zaps (5, cap 25 a day). Achievements First Tap, Card Shark and Open Door pay Zaps. The console writes Frequency-wide numbered cards (next_member_card_number, 1 to 100 Founders edition) for Crew members only, or Space cards (face_space_id); badge requests need Crew. Counter scan replies add optional greeting and perk, and refuse a paused card (card_paused). The Space page shows the cardholder perk. Migrations 20270346024000_member_card_faces.sql and 20270346024500_member_card_game.sql were applied to production 2026-10-22 on the owner's "update the database" (ledger rows at the file versions), and lib/database.types.ts carries the new tables. Firmware does not yet print greeting, perk or card_paused (hellofrequencylab/projects apps/frequency). Shipped in two PRs to stay under the 40-file gate: #3848 carried the migrations, the tap, the public card face, swap and the game; the second carried the Crew and Space editors and the staff console, and closed this row.
